candidate.answerReason: Using \(\cos^2\theta=1-\sin^2\theta\) gives \(25\cos^2\theta=25(1-9/25)=16\). No quadrant assumption is needed because cosine is squared.

methods.label: Find cosine squared
methods.levelReason: Uses the same-angle identity and elementary rational arithmetic with a square, within the stated curriculum.
